title: Repertoire and years in Atlanta
summary: He played any jazz, including Armstrong's pieces, in Atlanta in 1923-24.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: What were you playing? I mean, what kind of songs? Do you remember some of the songs?
Any kind, don't make no difference. All the jazz music.
Something like Louis Armstrong's compositions, things that he was playing?
I know, what year was this around in Atlanta or where you were doing all of this?
Well, that was in 1924, '23 and '24, when I was playing there because I left late in 1924.
